Chess Games Analytics — a single-page dynamic dashboard

20,058 online chess games (Lichess-style export): players, ratings, time controls, openings and outcomes. Every chart below reads from the same filtered dataset — change any filter in the bar and the whole page recomputes live. The dashboard tells one story in five acts: who plays (ratings & formats) → how games end (decisive vs. draw) → what openings are chosen (and where they trace from) → advanced diagnostics (Pareto/waterfall/trend/box) → where this is headed (forecast) and where openings trace from (geography).

⚠ Dataset has no player-location field. The map (Section 7) plots game counts by the traditional country of origin of the chess opening played (e.g. Sicilian → Italy, Ruy Lopez → Spain) — an approximation of opening ancestry, not where players actually live.
